description: A beam of crackling energy: a ranged spell attack for 1d10 force damage. Extra beams (separate attack rolls) at character levels 5, 11 and 17; one beam at level 1.
srd_description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage. The spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three beams at 11th level, and four beams at 17th level. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.
